hotel.label: Hotel website
hotel.prompt: Create a boutique hotel website for Shenzhen using a green palette of forest green (#1B4332), sage (#95D5B2) and off-white (#F8F9F4), with a sans-serif typeface and generous white space. Include: hotel introduction, four room cards (room type, size, nightly rate), amenities and services, nearby attractions, and booking contact details, all in a calm, airy holiday mood

museum.label: Lu Xun Memorial
museum.prompt: Create a Lu Xun Memorial Museum website in a parchment-scroll palette of aged paper (#EFE3C8), ink black (#2B2B2B) and seal red (#8C3A2B), with serif headings. Include: a life timeline, six cards showcasing his major literary works, a historical photo gallery, quoted passages, and visitor information, evoking a quiet, literary atmosphere

cafe.label: Local coffee shop
cafe.prompt: Create a cozy local coffee shop website with a warm palette of light beige (#F5EFE6), cream white (#FFFDF7) and soft wood brown (#8B7355), paired with serif typography and moderate spacing. Include a brand story, a menu of six drinks with prices, weekend event information, and the shop address with opening hours — concise copy that highlights the pour-over craft and the relaxed atmosphere

retroShop.label: 90s Electronic Museum
retroShop.prompt: Create a 90s retro shop webpage named 'Electronic Museum' with a cyberpunk palette of highly saturated neon pink (#FF10F0), cyan (#00FFFF) and charcoal black background (#1A1A1A), with pixel or monospace headings. Include six retro product cards (name, year, price) and six nostalgic news items at the bottom, with a neon glow on card hover, creating a nostalgic cyberpunk visual experience

pomodoro.label: Pomodoro timer
pomodoro.prompt: Create an immersive Pomodoro timer webpage. Features: a default 25-minute countdown with 'Start', 'Pause' and 'Reset' buttons, and a native browser alert when the countdown ends. Visual: a huge centered monospace clock over a pink (#FF6B9D) to purple (#7B2FF7) gradient background, with frosted-glass buttons and a clean, focused feel

saas.label: SaaS landing page
saas.prompt: Build a professional SaaS product landing page in deep navy (#0F172A), bright blue (#3B82F6) and light grey (#F1F5F9) with a sans-serif typeface. Include: a hero (headline, subheadline, call-to-action), six feature cards, three pricing tiers with a feature comparison and a highlighted recommendation, customer testimonials, an FAQ, and a footer — specific, professional copy and a clear conversion path

energyCore.label: Neon energy core
energyCore.prompt: Use Three.js to create a dark sci-fi energy core scene. Structure: a glowing energy sphere floating at the center (cyan #22D3EE blended with purple #8B5CF6), three metallic rings rotating slowly on different axes around it, roughly 800 tiny blue-violet particles drifting nearby, a soft halo on the ground, and a near-black background (#05050A). Interaction: drag to orbit the camera, scroll to zoom. Implementation: load Three.js and OrbitControls from a CDN and rely on built-in APIs such as SphereGeometry, TorusGeometry, MeshStandardMaterial, PointLight and Points; avoid complex shaders and heavy math, keep the code short

blackHole.label: Black hole disk
blackHole.prompt: Use Three.js to create a minimal black hole scene. Structure: a pure black sphere at the center (#000000, no specular highlight), a bright blue-violet accretion disk around it (#4C1D95 to #60A5FA) rotating slowly on the horizontal plane, roughly 2000 tiny star-dust particles scattered around, and a deep black background for a sense of cosmic depth. Interaction: drag to orbit the camera, scroll to zoom. Implementation: load Three.js and OrbitControls from a CDN and build the glow layers with TorusGeometry, SphereGeometry, Points and AdditiveBlending; no physics simulation

portal.label: Sci-fi portal
portal.prompt: Use Three.js to create a dark sci-fi portal scene. Structure: a large metallic ring standing upright at the center (dark grey #3F4A5A, metallic finish), a translucent blue energy veil inside it (#38BDF8), 12 small glowing modules spaced evenly around the rim, and a few particles with a thin haze around it. Motion: the veil brightens and dims in a roughly 3-second breathing cycle while the metal ring turns slowly. Interaction: drag to orbit the camera, scroll to zoom. Implementation: load Three.js and OrbitControls from a CDN and prefer TorusGeometry, CircleGeometry, MeshStandardMaterial, PointLight and Points over shader and math code

mechCube.label: Floating mech cube
mechCube.prompt: Use Three.js to create a futuristic floating cube scene. Structure: a dark metallic cube hovering at the center (#1F2937), wrapped in two translucent wireframe shells, with six cyan glowing modules (#22D3EE) attached to its faces; each layer rotates slowly in an opposite direction at its own speed. The background is pure black (#000000), blue motes drift around, and a soft ring of light sits underneath. Interaction: drag to orbit the camera, scroll to zoom. Implementation: load Three.js and OrbitControls from a CDN and prefer BoxGeometry, EdgesGeometry, LineSegments, MeshStandardMaterial and PointLight, keeping the code short

modelSettings.title: Model Settings
modelSettings.description: Tune the sampling parameters used for generation. Settings are saved locally and applied to the next run.

temperature.label: Temperature
temperature.hint: Sampling temperature. Higher is more random. Typical 0.6 – 1.2.

top_k.label: Top-K
top_k.hint: Sample only from the K most likely tokens. 0 disables it.

top_p.label: Top-P
top_p.hint: Nucleus sampling threshold. Lower = more conservative output.

max_tokens.label: Max Tokens
max_tokens.hint: Max tokens to generate per response. 4096+ recommended for long pages.

alpha_presence.label: Presence Penalty
alpha_presence.hint: One-shot penalty for tokens already used, reduces repetition.

alpha_frequency.label: Frequency Penalty
alpha_frequency.hint: Penalty that grows with token frequency. Suppresses repeated words.

alpha_decay.label: Penalty Decay
alpha_decay.hint: Decay factor for penalties. Closer to 1 decays slower.

chunk_size.label: Chunk Size
chunk_size.hint: Server-side batch size. Larger = higher throughput, more VRAM.
